title: Frontend Engineering Handbook
description: A comprehensive deep-notes handbook covering web fundamentals, JavaScript core, Git, tooling, TypeScript, React foundations, the React ecosystem, advanced topics, and capstone project skills — the perfect orientation for your frontend journey.

title: Internet Fundamentals
description: Understand how the internet works — network protocols, IP addresses, domain names, DNS, HTTP, TLS, hosting, and how browsers render pages.

title: HTML Reference Guide
description: A comprehensive HTML reference covering element categories, document structure, semantic tags, forms, and accessibility attributes.

title: CSS Reference Guide
description: Master CSS syntax, selectors, the box model, display types, visual formatting, and layout properties with this interactive reference guide.

title: DOM Masterclass
description: An interactive deep dive into the Document Object Model — tree structure, nodes vs elements, selectors, traversal, manipulation, and events.

title: JavaScript Interactive Book
description: A broad interactive JavaScript book covering core language fundamentals, data types, operators, control flow, functions, and practical examples.

title: JS Deep Dive: Objects, Prototypes & Classes
description: Master JavaScript objects, the prototype chain, ES6 classes, and inheritance patterns through interactive exercises.

title: JS Memory Mastery
description: An interactive deep dive into JavaScript memory management — the memory lifecycle, stack vs heap, the call stack, primitives vs references, and shallow vs deep copying.

title: Async JavaScript Deep Dive
description: Master asynchronous JavaScript — the event loop, callbacks, Promises, async/await, the Fetch API, and REST integration with a final quiz.

title: React useState Deep Dive
description: A deep dive into the useState hook — state with different data types, functional updates, batching, and forms integration.

title: React Hooks & Patterns Deep Dive
description: Master the full React hooks API — useState, useEffect, useReducer, useContext, and common patterns for building robust components.

title: React Forms & Validation
description: An interactive course on React forms — controlled and uncontrolled components, validation strategies, and handling user input effectively.

title: React API Integration & Custom Hooks
description: Learn how to build an API layer with Axios, create service files, write custom hooks for data fetching, and handle errors with retry logic.

title: React Ecosystem: Routing & SPAs
description: Explore the React ecosystem — SPA vs traditional websites, React Router setup, nested routes, dynamic params, Link vs NavLink, and controlled inputs.

title: React Performance & Accessibility
description: Master React performance optimization — the re-render cascade, React.memo, useMemo, useCallback, lazy loading, bundle size, and building accessible apps.

title: UI Kit & Design System
description: Learn what design systems are, how they're structured with design tokens, popular UI libraries, build-vs-buy decisions, and component design principles with props and variants.

title: Material UI Masterclass
description: An interactive masterclass on Material UI — setting up MUI, ThemeProvider, Button, TextField, Card components, and building a login form.

title: Git Reference Guide
description: A comprehensive interactive Git reference — basic commands, branching, merging, rebasing, stash, tags, and a quick reference cheat sheet.

title: Git Workflow & CI/CD Guide
description: Master Git workflow and CI/CD — branching strategies, pull requests, GitHub Actions, testing pipelines, and deployment automation.

title: intro.dev — Dev Environment Setup
description: A complete guide to setting up your development environment — installing Node.js, npm, editors, extensions, and configuring your first project.

title: Deployment Learning Guide
description: Learn how to deploy web applications — build outputs, environment variables, hosting platforms, DNS configuration, and CI/CD deployment pipelines.

title: Frontend Architecture & Planning
description: Learn frontend architecture fundamentals — requirements analysis, tech stack selection, project structure, component design, state management, and scalability patterns.

title: Testing Guide
description: A comprehensive interactive testing guide — unit tests, integration tests, E2E tests, testing frameworks, mocking, and testing best practices.

title: Frontend Authentication
description: Master frontend authentication — session vs token-based auth, JWT, OAuth, secure token storage, route protection, and common security pitfalls.

title: SQL Learning Page
description: An interactive SQL tutorial — SELECT queries, filtering, joins, aggregations, subqueries, and database design fundamentals with hands-on exercises.
